scripts.//typecheck: Two projects: the browser app (DOM + vite/client types) and the Worker (workers-types). They cannot share one tsconfig — `Fetcher`/`ExportedHandler` don't exist in DOM lib, and the Worker's globals conflict with DOM ones.
scripts.//lint: biome.jsonc lives at the repo root and covers the whole workspace; biome discovers it by walking up from the cwd, so plain `biome check .` here lints exactly this package with the shared config.
scripts.//cf:dev: wrangler dev serves the REAL Worker (redirects, /api/* seam, run_worker_first) against ./dist. `pnpm dev` is the fast Vite HMR loop but knows nothing about the Worker — use cf:dev to verify Worker behaviour, and build first so ./dist exists.

//dependency-notes.@cloudflare/workers-types: Major must track the peer wrangler declares (wrangler 4.x -> workers-types 5.x); a mismatched major types the Worker against a different runtime API surface.
//dependency-notes.@testing-library/jest-dom: v7, not v6 — 6.10.0 shipped breaking changes in a minor and is deprecated upstream. v7 needs Node >=22, which .nvmrc pins.
//dependency-notes.vitest: v4, not the v2 the plan named: vitest 2 depends on vite 5 internally, and because vitest.config.ts IS typechecked here, tsc reports the vite-5-vs-vite-7 `Plugin`/`UserConfig` type collision as ~40 errors. vitest 4 is the line whose peer range is vite ^6||^7||^8. Do not downgrade Vite to satisfy vitest.
//dependency-notes.jsdom: Only vitest uses it — never import it from src/.
